directory.name: Alibi Room
directory.note: A low-key pizzeria and lounge tucked into Pike Place Market's Post Alley, built around brick-oven pizza with a crisp, tender crust.

servesPizza.name: Cotto Belltown
servesPizza.note: An Italian restaurant and bar serving house-made pasta alongside wood-fired pizzas such as the Margherita.

servesPizza.name: Limoncello Belltown
servesPizza.note: An Italian restaurant best known for house-made pasta and a limoncello cocktail that also serves pizza on its dinner menu.

servesPizza.note: An Ethan Stowell Italian restaurant at the Washington State Convention Center whose oven-baked pizzas anchor a menu that also covers pasta, antipasto, and happy hour.

servesPizza.name: Von's 1000Spirits
servesPizza.note: A cocktail bar near Pike Place Market built around a 1,000-plus bottle spirits collection, whose food menu centers on Seattle sourdough pizzas and pastas.

servesPizza.note: A sports bar near Lumen Field with a custom stone oven that turns out house-made pizza alongside calzones and sandwiches.
